_comment: Union Vision. 'type' can be 'youtube' (default) or 'nfhs'. For youtube, 'id' is the YouTube video id. For nfhs, 'id' is the game id and 'url' is the full NFHS Network event URL. Optional 'thumb' is a full URL or local images/... path for the thumbnail. First entry runs large as the feature; rest fill the grid.
